'''Mike Million''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2001 Mainz tournament]] on 9 December 2001 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|Bring Him Before Me]] and [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|Quiet Mining Colony]], according to Vjeko Keskic's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3231">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-04-09-12-2001-mainz-germanyd3231/ 09-12-2001-mainz-germany], DeckTech (Vjeko "mighty_maul" Keskic, 4 January 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-04-09-12-2001-mainz-germanyd3231/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
